.box-list{ background:#fff; border:1px solid #d0d0ce; border-radius:5px; -webkit-border-radius:5px; padding:10px;}
ul.list-arrow-menu{
    margin: 20px 0px;
    background:#fff;
    padding:0;
}

ul.list-arrow-menu li {
    display: inline-block;
    line-height: 24px;
    margin:0px 0px 0 0;
    position: relative;
    text-align:center;

}
ul.list-arrow-menu li a{ text-align:center; }
ul.list-arrow-menu li:before {
    content: " ";
    height: 0;
    width: 0;
    position: absolute;
    left: -3px;
    border-style: solid;
    border-width: 24px 0 24px 24px;
    border-color: transparent transparent transparent #9a9995;
    z-index: 0;
}

ul.list-arrow-menu li:first-child:before {
    border-color: transparent;
}

ul.list-arrow-menu li a:after {
    content: " ";
    height: 0;
    width: 0;
    position: absolute;
    right: -24px;
    border-style: solid;
    border-width: 24px 0 24px 24px;
    border-color: transparent transparent transparent #fff;
    z-index: 10;
    top:0;
}

ul.list-arrow-menu li.active a {
    background: #0c6f8f;
    z-index: 100;
    color:#fff;

}


ul.list-arrow-menu li.active-not a{ background:#F5F4F0; margin-left:-2px;}
ul.list-arrow-menu li.active-not a:after {
    border-left-color: #F5F4F0;
}

ul.list-arrow-menu li.active a:after {
    border-left-color: #0c6f8f;
}
ul.list-arrow-menu li.active-first a{ background:#19ffff; margin-left:-2px;}
ul.list-arrow-menu li.active-first a:after {
    border-left-color: #19ffff;
}
ul.list-arrow-menu li.active-second a{ background:#0099de; margin-left:-2px;}
ul.list-arrow-menu li.active-second a:after {
    border-left-color: #0099de;
}

ul.list-arrow-menu li.active-third a{ background:#0066ff; color:#fff; margin-left:-2px;}
ul.list-arrow-menu li.active-third a:after {
    border-left-color: #0066ff;
}

ul.list-arrow-menu li.active-four a{ background:#000076; color:#fff; margin-left:-2px; text-align:center;}
ul.list-arrow-menu li.active-four a:after {
    border-left-color: #000076;

}

ul.list-arrow-menu li a {
    display: block;
    background: #fff;
    color:#000;
    text-decoration:none;
    padding-right:20px;
    padding-left:35px;
}

ul.list-arrow-menu li a:hover {
    background: #9bdbf6;
    color:#000;
}

ul.list-arrow-menu li a:hover:after {
    border-color: transparent transparent transparent #9bdbf6;
}
